turns.message: what the hell is sql injection
turns.ground_truth: SQL injection is an attack where untrusted input is inserted into a SQL query; defenses include parameterized queries/prepared statements, a safe ORM, positive input validation and least-privilege database accounts.

turns.message: what the hell happens during broken access control
turns.ground_truth: Deny access by default, enforce access control checks server-side, apply least privilege, disable directory listing, and log and alert on access-control failures.

Injection is a class of flaws where untrusted data is sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query, tricking it into executing unintended commands or accessing data; SQL injection is the most common form.

turns.message: Should I use preparde statements to stop sql injecion?
turns.ground_truth: Yes. Prepared statements with parameterized queries are the primary defense against SQL injection.

Use consultas parametrizadas o declaraciones preparadas, o una API/ORM segura; valide la entrada de forma positiva en el servidor; escape los caracteres especiales si quedan consultas dinámicas; y aplique cuentas de base de datos con privilegio mínimo.

turns.message: ¿Cómo se previene el control de acceso roto?
